---
title: A Source-Grounded Guide to Nutrition & Lifestyle Evidence
---

This is a **source-grounded appraisal** of the nutrition, exercise, and lifestyle evidence — what an
exposure does, *for whom*, *how much*, and *how confident we should be*, with every claim traced back to
the study or guideline it came from. It answers one question: **would this change what someone should do,
on an outcome they care about, in a way they couldn't already have reached?** If not, it isn't here.
[Read more about how this works and its honest limits →](about)

## Start here — guides for a situation

Each is a short, ranked, honestly-caveated guide.
